messages:
arjun: FYI nightly eval for 13B-quant is noisy, saw big drops in a few metrics on 2026-02-10.
jenna: saw the alert on the quality/regressions dashboard — BERTScore and pass@k are below the float baseline.
kai: please paste the runner output.
arjun: runner snippet:
```
model: redwood/13B-quant
samples_per_example: 20
seed_range: [1001..1020]
pass@k: 0.14 (expected 0.22)
bert_score: 0.605 (baseline 0.639)
```
michael: quick triage list: tokenizers, metric package versions, pass@k logic, normalization for BLEU/ROUGE.
jenna: we bumped bert-score to v0.3.14 in the eval image (PR 438) last week. That might change scoring behavior.
arjun: found a bug in pass@k impl in eval-runner: deduping across the whole batch before checking per-example matches.
kai: that's wrong — pass@k must be computed per instance. current pseudo-bug:
```
# buggy
global_set = set(flatten(samples))
pass_at_k = sum(ref in global_set for ref in refs) / N
```
we need per-example logic.
arjun: correct estimator when n_i samples per example and c_i correct samples:
pass@k = (1/N) * sum_i (1 - comb(n_i - c_i, k) / comb(n_i, k))
kai: I'll replace with the combinatorial estimator and add unit tests for edge cases (k>n, c_i=0, multiple corrects). will open PR and tag @jenna.
jenna: short-term mitigation: pin bert-score to 0.3.12 in Dockerfile so CI stable. long-term: make our wrapper load model_name explicitly or vendor golden embeddings for unit tests.
michael: BLEU/ROUGE mismatch traced to normalization: our ROUGE pipeline lowercases + strips punctuation, while sacrebleu expects detokenized text. propose switching to sacrebleu and python-rouge-score and standardizing normalization steps in docs.
arjun: quantization can cause small deltas, but the observed ~0.03 BERTScore gap is large. plan paired float vs quant runs with identical seeds and same I/O path to isolate quant error.
kai: adding deterministic seed harness to CI smoke job.
michael: I'll add ci job 'evals-smoke' that runs a tiny dataset and enforces tolerances: pass@k +/-0.02, BERTScore +/-0.015, BLEU +/-0.03. command example:
```
pytest tests/eval_smoke.py -k smoke --seed 1001 --model redwood/13B-quant
```
jenna: will push Dockerfile hotfix: bert-score==0.3.12 and add CHANGELOG note 'eval-image: pin bert-score for metric stability'.
arjun: also request: dashboard needs per-dataset breakdown — current aggregation hides task-specific regressions. add per-dataset JSON export to s3 for diffs.
kai: telemetry flag added to runner to emit per-dataset metrics JSON to s3 path prefix: s3://redwood-evals/per_dataset/YYYYMMDD/<model>/<run_ts>.json
michael: created tracking issue #512 eval/metric-compat for coordination. assigning tasks there.
arjun: I'll run paired CPU float vs quant with same seeds and attach CSV diffs to #512.
jenna: post-PR checklist: update eval-runner changelog, add smoke CI gating, and note in release docs: 'quant bring-up: expect small metric shifts; verify with smoke tests and paired runs'.
kai: PR opened: fix/pass-at-k + tests, linking #512. tagging @jenna @michael.
michael: thanks — will merge smoke CI job after Dockerfile hotfix lands.
eval-bot: deploy-notify: nightly-evals 1764127890 completed, artifacts at https://s3.redwood-inference/evals/1764127890/
